original_context_note: I compared problem.md:19–48, target-selection.json/full_target, proof-context.json/full_target, the complete basis-proof.md and the registry dependencies/replacements, together with retained basis-evidence-000.txt and basis-evidence-001.txt. spec.full_target preserves the exact selected text. The six H records retain positive dimensions, joint C∞ regularity, the fixed Euclidean unit vector, the unit constraint, merely pointwise existential normality, and slabwise compact support of the perturbation. Positive integers used as dimensions are represented by natural n,m with H001, an equivalent domain, without hiding their positivity in parameter types. No initial condition, time-zero assertion, regularity of a normality scalar, globally common support, or additional uniform bound is assumed. H003 is retained as an original root and is unused. D001–D007 define the fixed coordinate spaces, Euclidean dot/normSq, a total representative and standard directions. The explicit norm comparison in R001/S001 proves the coordinate-calculus identification and preserves standard-coordinate Lebesgue volume without scaling. D009–D018 preserve exactly V,A,Psp,Ssp,L,e,E,W,d and dx from the basis header, including coefficient 1 and the Frobenius sum. Their types agree with the actual coordinate derivatives; all requires arrays are empty legitimately because the representative and derivative/integral operators are total. In particular D016 does not grant integrability: R002 separately proves it. D008 is typed notation, not a theorem or extra hypothesis. Every N/P has one producer and the AND graph is acyclic: R001→N001, R002→N002, R003→N003, R004→N004, R005→N005, R006→P, with all non-H vertices in P's backward closure. B010–B015 are these internally proved outputs, never external roots. I checked each retained M001–M010 against its actual successful pinned probe and the defining Mathlib source context. M001 is continuous compact-support integrability; M002 preserves both ae-spatial-before-universal-time premises and both conclusions; M003 retains its real finite-dimensional Borel/Haar structures, all three integrability premises and the supportwise differentiability conditions; M004–M006 retain their full field, space and order conditions; M007 is actual locality of fderiv; M008 allows empty compact sets; M009 retains both finite-measure and finite-extended-norm conditions; M010 retains measurable-set necessity. B007's constant-derivative step is justified locally and B009 is realized by M009 plus M010 and the compact finite-measure argument. The registry has no provisional E ports, no category 2 or 4 dependency, and none was added. Evans is problem provenance, not an imported theorem premise. The ordered retrieval rule was read; there is no missing literature E primary text or deferred source assumption in this candidate. The authorized basis rewrite is preserved: native dominated differentiation replaces the original difference-quotient/DCT passage, and native scalar whole-space integration by parts replaces box FTC/Fubini. Its required bounding, quantifier-order, product-integrability and cancellation calculations are present. As explicitly authorized in basis-proof.md:31 and the replacement registry, the optional scalar formula and twice-differentiated constraint are omitted; the optional constancy corollary is also omitted because the full selected target is integrability, differentiability and zero derivative. This is my same-author closing inspection, with no independent Audit A or mathematical certification claimed.
